body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Do not accept Strain on this card. Remove 2 Strain from yourself and suppress one ordinary mental or pain Condition on the target until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Extend suppression through the end of your next turn.
Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Trance
rider.html: Enter Silence Trance until the end of your next turn: you cannot accept Strain, but gain +1 Composure. End the Trance voluntarily only at the start of your turn.
